text: Take your time. The mountain isn't going anywhere. Neither am I, apparently.
A small light, a very tall climb. Let's see how far it goes.
No need for a grand plan. The next ledge will do.
We'll start with one jump. Most regrettable decisions begin just as simply.
Up we go. The floor has had quite enough of our company.
Welcome back. I kept the mountain exactly where you left it.
